method: Read the one matching UTF-8 content row from the retained authenticated gzip JSONL cache, verified the cache snapshot digest and the row's commit/path/size/full-content digest, then re-read the exact newline-terminated bytes at the five frozen line numbers. No upstream code or network request was executed.

claim_rereads.line_text: - Integrate code scanning into the CI/CD pipeline.
claim_rereads.successor_statement: Include code scanning in delivery pipelines.
claim_rereads.fidelity_basis: The successor preserves code scanning and pipeline integration and removes the predecessor's unsupported static-analysis restriction. Delivery pipelines generalizes CI/CD without narrowing the source obligation.

claim_rereads.successor_statement: Regularly rotate secrets and credentials regardless of confirmed exposure.
claim_rereads.fidelity_basis: The successor restores regular actual rotation and both source object classes. The source states recurring rotation without an exposure precondition; the successor makes that lack of precondition explicit. Rotation authority remains unresolved.

claim_rereads.line_text: - Ensure policies are accessible to all team members.
claim_rereads.successor_statement: Make security guidance available to all team members; availability is distinct from having been trained.
claim_rereads.fidelity_basis: The successor restores the source's all-team audience. Its training distinction is an explicit review qualification and is not treated as additional source expression or proof of training.

claim_rereads.line_text: - Use role-based access control (RBAC) to limit access to GitHub and other business systems.
claim_rereads.successor_statement: Use role-based access control to limit access across GitHub and other business systems; explicit role assignments alone do not prove role-based enforcement.
claim_rereads.fidelity_basis: The successor restores role-based access control across GitHub and other business systems. Its enforcement caveat preserves the evidence boundary and does not weaken the source obligation; enforcement remains unproven.

claim_rereads.line_text: - Regularly audit access logs for suspicious activity for GitHub and other business systems.
claim_rereads.successor_statement: Regularly audit access logs for suspicious activity across GitHub and other business systems.
claim_rereads.fidelity_basis: The successor preserves recurring audit, suspicious-activity scope, and both system classes. The source does not establish a numeric cadence, so cadence remains unresolved.
